name: Menu
structurePatterns: floating rounded surface with floating elevation, anchored to a trigger
contains 2-6 menu items; optional group dividers separate sections
opens above/below trigger, flips when viewport space insufficient
dismisses on item select, outside press, or back/escape
usageHints: menu carries contextual actions, not page-level navigation
default action count is 2-6; destructive item placed last
no cascading multi-level submenus as the mobile default
close the menu before opening a blocking dialog or sheet
doNotInvent: no long-form content in a menu
no menu as a bottom-sheet replacement
